switchSteps.title: 1. Map one client first
switchSteps.body: List the client’s profiles, formats, scheduled posts and reviewers. Check which integrations and early-access features are live in your SocialMint workspace.

switchSteps.title: 2. Pilot the approval flow
switchSteps.body: Start the 14-day trial without a card. Recreate a small set of drafts and, when enabled, test an Agency approval link with a reviewer. Check publishing status and recovery before expanding.

switchSteps.title: 3. Move only verified workflows
switchSteps.body: Reconnect supported profiles and rebuild schedules in small batches. Remove duplicate scheduled posts in the old tool. Keep unsupported networks there until SocialMint support is available; no automatic history import is promised.

pages.title: Hootsuite alternative for small agencies (2026)
pages.description: Compare SocialMint and Hootsuite pricing, approvals and networks for small agencies. Honest early-access limits and September 2026 vendor sources.
pages.intro: A small-agency option for teams prioritizing client review links, a fixed five-user plan and a focused publishing workflow.
pages.audience: For agencies with up to five teammates and fifteen brands whose immediate work fits the launch networks, and who can pilot an early-access product before switching.

vendorCells.text: Standard: from $99/user/month, annual billing; 10 social accounts. Taxes extra.
Professional: $995/month for 5 seats (5 × $199), billed annually, unlimited accounts. Advanced with team approvals: $1,995 (5 × $399). Calculated totals; brands are not the billing unit.
Team approvals on Advanced. Login-free external reviewer links not confirmed here.
Documents publishing errors and resend/reschedule remedies. A per-post retry control was not verified.
Integration directory available; public API access and n8n plan eligibility not confirmed here.
Includes Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, X, TikTok, YouTube, Threads, Pinterest and Bluesky. Capabilities vary by network.
Hosting region not established by the pricing source; request contractual residency details.
14 days without a card. Trial posting limits apply; no bulk scheduling during trial.

pages.fits: SocialMint’s Agency offer combines 15 brands and 5 users for €49/month including VAT, with login-free client review and API + n8n planned in the September rollout. It fits a small team seeking this specific workflow and German hosting, provided early-access availability meets its needs.
pages.vendorFits: Hootsuite is the stronger fit when you need its already listed Instagram, Facebook and LinkedIn integrations. Professional includes custom reporting; Advanced adds team approvals. Agencies dependent on these capabilities should validate SocialMint’s narrower rollout before moving.

faq.question: Is SocialMint cheaper for a five-person agency?
faq.answer: SocialMint Agency lists €49/month including VAT for 5 users and 15 brands. Hootsuite Professional’s five-seat arithmetic is $995/month on annual billing before taxes. Currencies, billing periods and capabilities differ; these are not equivalent bundles.

faq.question: Can Hootsuite clients approve without a login?
faq.answer: The checked pricing page lists team approvals on Advanced, but does not establish login-free external approval links. Confirm that workflow with Hootsuite. SocialMint plans login-free Agency client links in its September rollout.

faq.question: Should an Instagram-focused agency switch now?
faq.answer: SocialMint’s Instagram, Facebook and LinkedIn support depends on platform approval. Keep workflows that require those networks in a supported tool until availability is confirmed.

faq.question: Do both trials require a credit card?
faq.answer: Neither SocialMint nor Hootsuite requires a card for its listed 14-day trial. SocialMint is early access, so use the trial to verify the features your clients need.

pages.title: Postiz alternative with client approvals (2026)
pages.description: Compare SocialMint with Postiz cloud and self-hosting: agency pricing, client approval links, API and networks. Checked September 2026.
pages.intro: A managed agency option for teams seeking client approval links without reviewer accounts and hosting in Germany.
pages.audience: For small agencies that prefer a managed service and want to pilot client approvals across up to fifteen brands, with no infrastructure to maintain themselves.

vendorCells.text: Cloud Standard: $29/month, 5 channels, unlimited posts. Team: $39/month, 10 channels, unlimited team members.
Pro: $49/month, 30 channels, unlimited team members. Fits 15 brands only if they total ≤30 channels. Ultimate: $99/month, 100 channels. Taxes not clarified on the page.
Customer groups and team collaboration listed; login-free external approval links not confirmed here.
API error handling documented. A visible per-post retry workflow was not verified.
Public API and custom n8n node documented.
Includes all five SocialMint launch networks plus LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube and more.
Self-hosting lets you choose infrastructure. Cloud hosting region not confirmed by the pricing page.
7-day cloud trial listed; card requirement not stated in the checked pricing FAQ.

pages.fits: SocialMint fits teams that want a managed service hosted in Germany and a plan defined around brands and five teammates. Its Agency client approval links are designed for reviewers without accounts. Pilot the September rollout to confirm this workflow is available before relying on it.
pages.vendorFits: Postiz fits teams that want to self-host or need a broader network selection today. Its documented API and n8n node already support automation. Unlimited team members on eligible cloud plans can suit teams larger than SocialMint Agency’s five-user allowance.

faq.question: Is SocialMint an open-source or self-hosted Postiz replacement?
faq.answer: SocialMint is presented here as a managed service hosted in Germany. Postiz offers an open-source self-hosting option; operating its server and integrations remains your responsibility.

faq.question: Does Postiz Pro cover fifteen brands?
faq.answer: Pro lists 30 channels and unlimited team members for $49/month. Fifteen brands fit that account allowance only if they use at most 30 connected profiles combined; brands and channels are different units.

faq.question: Is API automation unique to SocialMint?
faq.answer: No. Postiz documents a public API and custom n8n node. SocialMint Agency includes API + n8n in its September 2026 early-access rollout; verify readiness before migrating automations.

faq.question: Can clients review SocialMint posts without signing up?
faq.answer: Login-free client approval links are part of the Agency offer rolling out in September 2026. Verify the feature in your workspace during the 14-day trial without a card. The checked Postiz sources do not establish an equivalent login-free review flow.
